request.style: English, pop punk, fast drums, bright distorted guitars, a nasal male lead and a sing-along gang chorus, energetic and urgent, 156 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
What good is it, my brothers
If someone says he has faith
But does not have works
Can that faith save him

[Verse]
If a brother or sister is poorly clothed
And lacking daily food
And you say, go in peace, be warm and filled
Without giving what they need

[Chorus]
Faith without works is dead
Faith without works is dead
Show me your faith with nothing to show
I'll show you my faith by what I do

[Verse]
So also faith by itself
If it does not have works
Is dead, is dead
Get up and give

[Chorus]
Faith without works is dead
Faith without works is dead
Show me your faith with nothing to show
I'll show you my faith by what I do
